description: This file implements UBUS communication functions for interacting with ubus, including calling methods, handling cache, and event listening, specific to the dmubus API.

methods.name: dm_libubus_init
methods.description: Initializes ubus connection.

methods.name: dm_libubus_free
methods.description: Frees ubus context.

methods.name: prepare_blob_message
methods.description: Prepares a blob message with given ubus arguments.

methods.name: receive_call_result_data
methods.description: Processes ubus call response data into JSON.

methods.name: __dm_ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call asynchronously.

methods.name: __ubus_call_blocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking ubus call.

methods.name: dmubus_call_set
methods.description: Calls a ubus method with arguments and cleans up.

methods.name: dmubus_listen_timeout
methods.description: Handles listen timeout for ubus events.

methods.name: dmubus_wait_for_event
methods.description: Waits for a specific ubus event or timeout.

methods.name: ubus_call_req
methods.description: Wrapper for ubus call request returning JSON.

methods.name: dmubus_call_blob
methods.description: Calls a ubus method with a JSON object argument.

methods.name: dmubus_call_blob_set
methods.description: Sets a ubus object with a JSON argument.

methods.name: djbhash
methods.description: Hash function based on D. J. Bernstein's algorithm.

methods.name: dm_ubus_req_hash_from_blob
methods.description: Generates a hash for ubus request based on object, method, and attributes.

methods.name: dm_ubus_cache_lookup
methods.description: Looks up cache entry by hash.

methods.name: dm_ubus_cache_entry_new
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: dm_ubus_cache_entry_free
methods.description: Frees a cache entry.

methods.name: dmubus_call
methods.description: Performs a cached or direct ubus call with arguments.

methods.name: dmubus_object_method_exists
methods.description: Checks if a method exists in a ubus object.

methods.name: dmubus_free
methods.description: Frees cache and ubus context.
